collect._why_three_runs: The performance score is a MEASUREMENT of execution on the runner, not a property of the bytes. At numberOfRuns=1 a single noisy sample IS the result: on 2026-07-27 an unchanged site (build hash b0190ed6, zero website files touched across 8 commits) scored >=0.90 six times and 0.87 once, failing CI. TBT is 30% of the score and LCP 25%, and both inflate under CPU contention on a shared runner. Three runs let the median discard one outlier. Every threshold is deliberately UNCHANGED — this makes the gate measure the site rather than the weather.

assert._why_median: Explicit rather than assumed: assert on the median of the three runs, so one stalled run cannot fail the build and one lucky run cannot hide a real regression.
